changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Fusion') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Fusion]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [FusionTypeID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](max) NULL, [Enabled] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Fusion_Enabled] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [Manual] [bit] NOT NULL, [LockPromotedItems] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Fusion_LockPromotedItems] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [IntervalType] [int] NULL, [Interval] [int] NULL, [ForceRefresh] [bit] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Fusion] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Fusion_FusionType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Fusion] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Fusion_FusionType] FOREIGN KEY([FusionTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FusionType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Fusion] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Fusion_FusionType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Fusion_FusionTypeID') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Fusion_FusionTypeID] ON [dbo].[Fusion] ( [FusionTypeID] ASC ) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Fusion_AfterDelete] ON [dbo].[Fusion] AFTER DELETE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON delete Asset where Object = 'Fusion' and ObjectID in (select ID from deleted) END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Fusion_AfterInsert] ON [dbo].[Fusion] AFTER INSERT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON INSERT INTO [dbo].[Asset] ([AssetTypeID],[State],[Object],[ObjectID],[CreatedOn],[CreatedBy],[UpdatedOn],[UpdatedBy]) SELECT T.ID, 1, 'Fusion', O.ID, O.[UpdatedOn], O.[UpdatedBy], O.[UpdatedOn], O.[UpdatedBy] FROM inserted O inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'FusionType' and T.ObjectID = O.FusionTypeID END

changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER TRIGGER [dbo].[Fusion_AfterUpdate] ON [dbo].[Fusion] AFTER UPDATE AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON update T set T.UpdatedBy = S.UpdatedBy, T.UpdatedOn = S.UpdatedOn from Asset T inner join inserted S on T.Object = 'Fusion' and T.ObjectID = S.ID END
